plugins.publishCmd: V="${nextRelease.version}"; sha256sum LogForwarder.zip > LogForwarder.zip.sha256 && az storage blob upload --account-name nrloggingprodreleases --container-name releases --name log-forwarder-$V.zip --file LogForwarder.zip --auth-mode login --overwrite && az storage blob upload --account-name nrloggingprodreleases --container-name releases --name log-forwarder-$V.zip.sha256 --file LogForwarder.zip.sha256 --auth-mode login --overwrite && case "$V" in *-*) CUTOFF=$(date -u -d '30 days ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); az storage blob list --account-name nrloggingprodreleases --container-name releases --auth-mode login --query "[?contains(name, '-develop.') && properties.lastModified < '$CUTOFF'].name" -o tsv | xargs -r -I{} az storage blob delete --account-name nrloggingprodreleases --container-name releases --name {} --auth-mode login || true;; esac
